tool_input.command:
D=~/.config/systemd/user; U=zz-cgtest-$$; cat > /home/kris/garden2/scratch/cgt-post.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo "STOPPOST cg=$(cat /proc/self/cgroup) svc_result=${SERVICE_RESULT:-} exit=${EXIT_CODE:-}"
cg=$(sed -n 's/^0:://p' /proc/self/cgroup); for p in $(cat /sys/fs/cgroup$cg/cgroup.procs); do echo "in-cg: $p $(tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$p/cmdline)"; done
EOF
cat > /home/kris/garden2/scratch/cgt-main.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
setsid bash -c 'trap "" TERM; exec -a straggler301 sleep 301' &
sleep 0.2; echo main-exit; exit 0
EOF
cat > $D/$U.service <<EOF
[Service]
Type=oneshot
KillMode=mixed
TimeoutStopSec=5s
ExecStart=/bin/bash /home/kris/garden2/scratch/cgt-main.sh
ExecStopPost=/bin/bash /home/kris/garden2/scratch/cgt-post.sh
EOF
systemctl --user daemon-reload; systemctl --user start $U; sleep 7; journalctl --user -u $U --no-pager -o short-precise | tail -15; pgrep -af straggler301; rm -f $D/$U.service; systemctl --user daemon-reload
